title: Reductions of the integral scalar fibre comparison
statement: In the setting of [lem-pod-lisse-integral-scalar-fiber-map], write S=O_L, J=(pi_L), M=F_y, W=S tensor_O_E M, and D for the stalk tower of the extended integral system. For every n, the composite W→lim D→D_n of the canonical scalar fibre comparison with the projection is surjective and has kernel J^(n+1)W.

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp. 146-147; finite-level scalar stalk comparison; adic reconstruction as in Stacks Tag 09B8

proof.text: For any ideal I and module M, identify the adjunction unit M→(R/I) tensor_R M with the quotient M→M/IM using quotient tensor equivalence and uniqueness of left adjoints. It is surjective with kernel IM.

The recorded ramification index e satisfies sourceIndex(n)=n/e and map(I_E^(sourceIndex(n)+1))≤J^(n+1). Use the DVR witness to identify the uniformizer ideal with the maximal ideal; the arithmetic inequality is n < e*(n/e+1).

The source projection is surjective and its kernel is killed after extension to S/J^(n+1), so its scalar extension is an isomorphism. An explicit inverse descends the scalar adjunction unit through the projection kernel.

Compose this source projection isomorphism, associativity of scalar extension, finite-level scalar/stalk comparison and the recorded level isomorphism. On a germ representative the resulting map is precisely the finite-level projection of the canonical scalar comparison. Adjunction and the defining pure-germ formula prove equality. Its last quotient unit has the claimed kernel and surjectivity, and the other factors are isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem lisseIntegralScalarFiberComparison_reductions (F : LisseIntegralSheaf l E Y)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let S := Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l L
    let J := Ideal.span ({Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l L} : Set S)
    let M := (ModuleCat.ringExtendScalars.{d + 1, d + 1}
      (lisseIntegerInclusion l E L ι)).obj (lisseIntegralFiber l E Y y F)
    let D := ((lisseIntegralScalarExtensionData l E Y L ι).functor.obj F).obj ⋙
      (pointSmallEtale y).ulift.{d + 1}.sheafFiber
    let q := (lisseIntegralScalarFiberComparison Y y l E L ι F ≫ limit.π D (op n)).hom
    Function.Surjective q ∧ LinearMap.ker q = J ^ (n + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule S M)
